PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: Link your tools to one owned or faction-shared inventory port outside combat.
PluginData.Description:
Lanyard connects your tools to one owned or explicitly faction-shared inventory port.
Welder: supplies build-planner components through normal conveyor access. Grinder: returns ore, ingots and components. Drill: returns ore.
Equip a tool, aim at an inventory access port and type /ly to connect.
Open K > Lanyard or /ly menu for status, planner availability, tool switches, HUD preferences and shortcuts.
/ly off disconnects. /ly pause and /ly resume keep your connection while stopping or restarting automatic transfers.
/ly bounds previews the targeted grid. /ly bounds linked shows your linked working area. /ly bounds off hides it. Commands also accept /lanyard.
Stay inside the linked grid's bounds. Combat or enemy overlap starts a two-minute pause. Quiet joins do not. The timer pauses while you are away.
Connection and cooldown survive rejoining when the same player, container and port identities are preserved.
